page: Microsoft Azure E160ads_v7 is an Eadsv7-family virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 160 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 80 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 1280.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided via 9449 GB of local disk capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top 10% tier across multiple performance vectors. The AMD EPYC processor achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 287659.31 and a PassMark CPU score of 144267.77. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 14497.71 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 210.18 GB/sec. In database-specific workloads, the server processes 202.43 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 41416.44 in PassMark database operations.

This instance offers high resource density, combining massive memory capacity with substantial local storage. While it lacks GPU acceleration, its CPU-based LLM inference speeds reach 371.42 tokens/sec for medium (7B) model prompt processing. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and large local storage capacity make it suitable for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data decompression, and high-throughput static web serving.
